resolved.title: 变量赋值
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Working with Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Need to change the value of a variable? Easy. Variables can be reassigned as many times as you want. Like this: [code format="py"]x = 123.456
print(x)

x = "This is a string"
print(x + "!")[/code]
[note]But Beware! Overwriting the same variable with different data types is not good practice. To avoid mistakes, try to avoid doing it.[/note]

resolved.title: 输出变量
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定的程序声明了两个变量：**name** 和 **age** 。

完善代码，输出 "**name** is **age** years old"，其中 **name** 和 **age** 是声明的变量值。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re making a contact management system.

The given program declares two variables, [b]name [/b]and [b]age[/b].

Complete the code to output "[b][i]name[/i] is [i]age[/i] years old[/b]", where [b]name[/b] and [b]age[/b] are the declared variable values.
[note]You can add together strings using the + operator. And don't forget about spaces.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 你可以使用`+`运算符将字符串相加。而且不要忘记空格。
